description: 大分バスGTFSデータ [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. 路線バス（バス会社：大分バス）に関する「標準的なバス情報フォーマット（GTFS準拠）」形式のデータです。 （注意事項） ・最新の情報と異なる場合があります。 ・本データの利用によって発生した直接または間接の損失、損害等について、大分県は一切責任を負いません。 ・最新の情報や詳細については、各バス事業者のホームページ等を参照ください。 （外... Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are GTFS, バス, 交通, 観光, 運輸. It offers 1 resource(s) in gtfs. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
